expected: After June 11 without a year, answering 2099 updates start_date to 2099-06-11 and returns review.
actual: HTTP 200, start_date remains 2099-06-10, state stays collecting and repeats the year question.
impact: User cannot complete this correction using a bare-year reply in the observed runs. Existing valid draft remains intact.
root_cause: Original API failures did not capture model output. Three later instrumented original-prompt runs passed: correct model operations survived normalization and cleared the session issue. Prompt ambiguity is the suspected contributor, not a proven sole cause.
next_step: Retain this regression case in future evaluations; the limited sample does not establish a statistical reliability improvement.
fix: Explicitly allow unambiguous pending-question answers to supply context-dependent edits; combine the pending proposed month/day with the new year rather than the old saved date.
